data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves totaling $133.077 million, representing 17.85% of opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development is primarily attributed to losses on the 2019 closed year of account ($67.937 million) and the 2020 open year of account ($65.140 million). Additionally, the 2021 financial year was impacted by an above-average year for natural catastrophe claims, particularly from multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States, affecting both MGA Insurance and Reinsurance classes.
raw_causal_phrases: an above average year for natural catastrophe claims
multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is derived from the sum of losses on the 2019 closed year of account and the 2020 open year of account, as presented in the underwriting year of account results. This differs from the movement in claims incurred derived from the gross claims development triangle, which showed a strengthening of $1.969m. The YOA result is considered a more comprehensive measure of prior year development in this context.
